notes: Sets the statutory minimum wage as a proportion of the average wage and the monthly/daily/hourly derivations, with criminal and civil enforcement. IMPORTANT for a human: the numeric minimum wage in force is NOT fixed by this Act alone - it is updated by the mechanism in the Act together with collective-agreement extension orders (צווי הרחבה) and periodic Ministry of Labour notices, so encoding the Act gives the formula, not the current shekel figure. The Knesset LatestPublicationDate (2017-11-07) and the Wikisource 'תשע"ח' last amendment are the same amendment cycle.
